scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=dist/renderer.js && esbuild src/aiVideoBootstrap.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --outfile=dist/ai-video-bootstrap.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/index.html','dist/index.html')"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac dmg
